original.description: Handwheel and spindle turn to sand off matter and gift the world with helices and round things. Metal dust accrues on the ground beneath.

source_shape: Left tall headstock with low wheel/opening, right slim tailstock, two opposed detail-colored spindle tips, long horizontal bed with left underside carriage, one narrow left pedestal with lateral short marks and broad low foot.

palette.primary: y on metal headstock, wheel, bed, supports and foot
palette.detail: Y only opposed spindle tips at source row5
palette.rule: Neutral metal plus independent tip ownership; no donor teal/brown or fixed gold color baked into production.

native_state: One fixed Items/sw_lathe.bmp. No TileAnimationFrames or alternate body tile in exact Lathe/MountedFurniture/Furniture chain. ChargeSink consumes native charge; Rotation is status label, not evidence of render frames. Inherited power status/rare Animated fallback remains native.

findings: ChargeSink derives IPoweredPart, WorksOnSelf=true, TurnTick calls ConsumeChargeIfOperational. No Tile/Render/ColorString/DetailColor override in inspected ChargeSink class.
Hydraulic/electrical transmission and inherited powered/status behavior remain native; no replacement of power or rotation logic.
native_code_study.scope: Static metadata study only; native rotation/status acceptance pending.

native_behavior: HydraulicPowerTransmission and ElectricalPowerTransmission consumers ChargeRate1000; ChargeSink ChargeUse10 NameForStatusRotation; Metal, AV10, HP300, non-solid300weight, non-takeable mounted furniture; native cover/status/examiner complexity1 remain intact.

reference.role: Actual VFE Props and Decor fabrication small lathe north texture: compact metal end housings, opposed tip readability, simple shading only. Decorative source described as fabrication laser; Qud description/shape governs identity. Do not copy its workbench mounting, second full housing, brown material, drawSize2/footprint or decorative mechanics.
reference.equivalence: Partial spindle/housing style reference, not a replacement machine or physical dimension source.

construction.camera: One fixed cardinal source map face with horizontal bed and opposed horizontal spindle axis; no converging bed or whole-object yaw.
construction.source_supported: Left headstock, slim right upright, opposed Y tips at row5, long rail at row10, left underside mass and single pedestal/foot. Source wheel opening retained.
construction.authored: Rounded headstock/wheel, chamfered bed, short load-bearing connectors under headstock/tailstock and continuous pedestal supporting rail replace isolated glyph fragments. Connections and exact hidden thickness/depth are authored; no second pedestal, held workpiece, dust pile, tools, motor props or motion frames.
construction.openings: Wheel center, space between opposed tips and open under-bed field retain genuine transparent alpha.

frame.rule: One full source cell, fixed geometry and independent tip role; no generated bounds fitting or component recentering.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation: native charge/rotation status, hydraulic/electrical behavior, non-solid physics, examiner/cover/visibility and save/load; no production activation.
